verdict.rationale: Cerebras ships official SDKs. The quickstart installs a first-party Python package (`pip install cerebras_cloud_sdk`). The Cerebras GitHub org hosts an official TypeScript/JavaScript SDK (cerebras-cloud-sdk-node), which includes SDK-specific optimizations such as TCP warming to reduce TTFT. OpenAI API compatibility also lets existing OpenAI SDKs work by changing only the key, base URL and model ID. Missing for 10: detailed SDK reference documentation in the evidence, independent hands-on corroboration of the official SDKs, and evidence of SDKs beyond Python and TypeScript.
